readme:
## The box worker as a HoBo Fleet member (L34)

With a `fleet` block in the box checkout's `.hobo/ci.json` (D61: `authorityUrl`, `fleet`, `tenant`, `region`, optional `memberName` and `sandbox`), `scripts/isolated-worker-daemon.mts` composes `createFleetAgent` (`composeFleetDaemon`, `src/fleet-daemon.ts`) as a `DEDICATED` member with roles `DISPATCHER` and `EXECUTOR`:

| Part | Source |
|---|---|
| Capacity | The worker's admission (`capacityFromAdmission`): no free slot unless memory, storage and host health all admit; `DRAINING` while it drains, `PRESSURED` under host pressure |
| Work kind | `github-actions-job` (L16) with `createJitRegistrationMinter`; the daemon's own poller is off in fleet mode |
| Sandboxes | `sandboxDrivers` of `@hobo/fleet-agent` (gVisor `runsc` provisioned by the agent, D58) |
| Egress | `createEgressProxyFactory`, allowlist from the fleet policy |
| Bus | `createNatsBusConnector` of `@hobo/fleet-nats` |

First start enrolls with the bootstrap token in the file named by `HOBO_FLEET_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE`; later starts reuse the key store in `HOBO_FLEET_HOME` (default beside the journal). Those two paths are the only fleet inputs read from the process.

The routing slip (ADR-0181) stays: its decision (`routing-slip-decision.ts`) asks `fleetVerdict` of `@hobo/fleet/observation` over this box and its fleet peers, and its issuer writes only on the fleet's rank-0 `DISPATCHER` (`routingSlipLeader`).

Every container the worker starts (`createCliDockerDriver`) is hardened per S1 (`src/isolated-worker/container-flags.ts`): all capabilities dropped, `no-new-privileges`, a pids limit, a read-only root with a tmpfs `/tmp` and container-owned volumes for the runner's directories. The host Docker socket is mounted only while the fleet sets `allow_host_docker` and the box is `DEDICATED`. Trunk release and unlaunched-reservation release count peer slots from the fleet view's `FleetCapacity` (`src/peer-capacity.ts`).

The relay mesh, the published `HOBO_CI_FLEET_*` variables and the local runner are gone; a developer machine is a `PERSONAL` member running `hobo fleet run` (see `LOCAL-DEVELOPMENT.md`).
